# `curb_razor_markup_engine_quirks`

Experimental. With curb_razor_format_markup, indent markup by tab_width rather than indent_size, as Microsoft's Razor formatter does.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` | |
| `false` | |

**Default:** `false`

Microsoft's Razor formatter indents by `tab_width` and ignores `indent_size`. Curb indents markup by `indent_size`, as it does C#; this key makes it use `tab_width` instead, for a repository that wants its Razor files to stay exactly as the IDE formats them. The examples here are at `indent_size = 2`.

### `curb_razor_markup_engine_quirks = true`

```ini
curb_razor_markup_engine_quirks = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```html
<div class="card">
<h3>@Title</h3>
@if (Items.Count > 0)
{
<ul>
@foreach (var item in Items)
{
<li>@item</li>
}
</ul>
}
</div>
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```html
<div class="card">
    <h3>@Title</h3>
    @if (Items.Count > 0)
    {
        <ul>
            @foreach (var item in Items)
            {
                <li>@item</li>
            }
        </ul>
    }
</div>
```
:::

::::
